AGENDA
  GLENDALE SPECIAL CHARTER REVIEW COMMITTEE

  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206

  Teleconferencing Location
  229 Advance Technology Building
  Glendale Community College
  1500 North Verdugo Road
  Glendale, CA 91208

This meeting will be broadcast live on Glendale TV2, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 21, and
AT&T U-verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on
YouTube.com/myglendale. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at
glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and
questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will
be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the
agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular
business hours.

  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’s office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E Broadway, Room 110, Glendale CA 91206.

Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
with to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contracting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 AT 5:30 PM

1. ROLL CALL
 2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the September 10, 2026 Special Charter Review Committee Meeting was
  posted on Thursday, September 3, 2026, before 5:30 PM on the bulletin board outside City
  Hall.

3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Special Charter Review Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and
  report.

4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Meeting of July 2, 2026.

5. STAFF COMMENTS

6. BUSINESS/DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. Review Draft Charter Amendment Language Regarding Office of the City Auditor and
  Independent Audit Commission
  b. Review the Draft Final Report Summarizing the Committee's Recommendations for
  Submission to the City Council.

7. REPORTS - INFORMATION

8. FUTURE AGENDAS

9. ADJOURNMENT
